statement: Whenever check_if_exist returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < len(arr), 0 <= j < len(arr), i != j, and arr[i] = 2 * arr[j] as mathematical integers. If no such pair of indices exists, then r = false.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: For every arr satisfying the preconditions, the call check_if_exist arr returns a Bool result r and does not fail, panic, go out of bounds, or overflow.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever check_if_exist returns true, there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < len(arr), 0 <= j < len(arr), i != j, arr[i] is even, arr[j] = arr[i] / 2 using exact integer division, and arr[i] = 2 * arr[j].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: Whenever check_if_exist returns true, there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(arr) such that -500 <= arr[j] <= 500 and there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(arr), i != j, and arr[i] = 2 * arr[j].
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: For every bijection p from {0, ..., len(arr)-1} to itself, let arr_p be the slice of length len(arr) defined by arr_p[k] = arr[p(k)] for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr). Then check_if_exist arr_p returns the same Bool result as check_if_exist arr.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: Let neg be the slice of length len(arr) defined by neg[k] = -arr[k] for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr). Then check_if_exist neg returns the same Bool result as check_if_exist arr.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: For every integer c with c >= 1 such that -1000 <= c * arr[k] <= 1000 for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), let scaled_c be the slice defined by scaled_c[k] = c * arr[k]. Then check_if_exist scaled_c returns the same Bool result as check_if_exist arr.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: For every integer x with -1000 <= x <= 1000, let arr' be the slice of length len(arr)+1 obtained by appending x to arr. If check_if_exist arr returns true, then check_if_exist arr' returns true.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 2, len(arr) < 500, and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.

statement: For every index k with 0 <= k < len(arr), let arr_k be the slice of length len(arr)-1 obtained by deleting the element at position k. If check_if_exist arr returns false, then check_if_exist arr_k returns false.
preconditions: len(arr) >= 3 and len(arr) <= 500 and for every k with 0 <= k < len(arr), -1000 <= arr[k] <= 1000.
